# Research: <topic>

## Context (two sentences: who, where, when, why it matters now)

## News hook
Anniversary, new evidence, new documentary or trend (with the date and a link).

## Facts (6-10, surprising and verifiable; 5+ sources from 3+ sites, at least one primary or contemporary)

| 1 | | | high / check |

## Real media (archival photos, documents, footage: FBI Vault, NARA, LOC, NASA, NSF, Internet Archive, university and state
## archives, CC BY uploads, Commons) — at least 40% of the evidence, footage first
Forum leads (Reddit, Hacker News, specialist boards) count only with a confirming primary or reputable source in the Facts table.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## No real media
Only if none exists: say why, and which images are reconstructions.

## Open loop and payoff
The detail held back in the first 5 s, and the line that pays it off.
